observedUnresolvedDependencies.declaration: The fixed upstream package.json uses unresolved caret ranges. These declarations are audit evidence only and are forbidden as runtime installation inputs.

sessionModel.evidence: The fixed source stores one module-global currentSession. Calling start_session replaces it. The embedded HTTP state store can hold multiple IDs, but MCP tools operate only on currentSession.
sessionModel.isolationAssessment: Safe narrowing is feasible by spawning one patched MCP process and one Specline-owned HTTP service per session, never exposing upstream start_session, and binding lifecycle ownership to the Specline session.

pathBehavior.load: load_diagram accepts an arbitrary string, resolves it with node:path.resolve, and reads it directly with fs.readFile.
pathBehavior.export: export_diagram accepts an arbitrary string, resolves it with node:path.resolve, appends or replaces an extension, and writes directly with fs.writeFile.
pathBehavior.assessment: The upstream tools do not enforce a managed root, traversal boundary, extension allowlist for load, or symlink containment. They must never be exposed directly.

networkBehavior.httpBind: The embedded MCP HTTP server binds 127.0.0.1.
networkBehavior.browserUrl: start_session opens http://localhost:<port>?mcp=<sessionId>, not the contractually required 127.0.0.1 URL.
networkBehavior.drawioBaseUrl: DRAWIO_BASE_URL defaults to https://embed.diagrams.net and can be set to a local fixed webapp URL.
networkBehavior.bridge: The browser bridge polls same-origin HTTP endpoints and communicates with the draw.io iframe through postMessage. Mutating bridge endpoints have no bearer-token check.

mitigationFeasibility.licenseBasis: The fixed MCP work and draw.io editor code are Apache-2.0; the draw.io archive also carries the audited bundled icon, stencil, template, and third-party terms recorded above. Apache-2.0 permits reproduction, redistribution, and derivative modification when the license copy, applicable notices and attributions, and prominent modification notices are supplied. The bundled-asset restriction does not prohibit this non-Atlassian Specline runtime but must remain preserved. No source-offer obligation applies.
mitigationFeasibility.securityBasis: Each observed gap is at a replaceable boundary: package resolution, process launch, public tool mapping, filesystem path resolution, and loopback bridge request handling. A Specline-owned wrapper or Apache-2.0 derivative patch can fail closed without broadening upstream authority.
mitigationFeasibility.conclusion: All known gaps are legally and technically narrowable under the revised contract; none requires remote fallback, arbitrary filesystem access, or direct exposure of the original upstream interfaces.

requiredMitigations.requirement: Resolve the fixed MCP tarball into a lockfile or vendor manifest containing every transitive artifact's official source, exact version, integrity and SHA-256. Installation must reject missing entries, ranges, source drift, or checksum mismatch and must never resolve dependencies online at runtime.

Patch or replace the upstream launch boundary so only Specline creates the browser URL, exactly as 127.0.0.1 with an ephemeral owned port. Do not expose or invoke the original start_session URL path, localhost aliases, remote UI defaults, or remote fallback.

Generate an in-memory random bearer token per session and require it on every bridge read, write, sync, history, restore, preview, and export endpoint. Validate session identity, loopback peer, and trusted same-origin on every request; never place the token in URLs, CLI JSON, files, artifacts, or logs.

Expose only diagram.create/load/edit/readState/export/finish. Resolve identities inside the managed diagram root and reject absolute paths, traversal, invalid extensions, and symlink escape before any upstream call. Original upstream load_diagram, export_diagram, start_session, arbitrary path parameters, and unauthenticated bridge routes must be unreachable.
Run one owned patched MCP process and one owned loopback HTTP service per Specline session, with independent state, token, port, PID, revision, diagram identity, and idempotent cleanup.

After Tasks 9-11 and final wiring, capture DNS, HTTP, and WebSocket traffic for create, manual edit, sync, .drawio export, and SVG export. The trace must show zero non-loopback requests; any remote request or fallback keeps release verification failed.

Keep installation, public MCP tool exposure, and release disabled unless the immutable closure, launch, auth, managed path, interface sealing, license materials, and final network trace are all verified.
